comments.text: Lufthansa literally abandoned myself and a planeload of passengers at the Nuremberg airport (it was a deviated flight from Valencia to Frankfurt). Two hours later we were told to sort ourselves out and myself and four other passengers rented the last car so we could try to get the next leg of our flights. comments.text:
Lufthansa still refuses to reimburse the ticket. The case is already in court. This is the worst airline when it comes to bureaucratic procedures.

They wrongfully denied a member of my family boarding, and when they realized that they had had no right to refuse her because all her documents were in order, they simply lied and recorded the reason as a no-show at boarding.

When I tried to resolve the matter with them amicably, they did not respond to my email for about eight months. Then they finally replied, saying that my claim was unfounded and that there was nothing more I could do about it.

I appealed, and the case went to something similar to a German court. There, Lufthansa admitted that it had made a mistake, but claimed that it could not pay me because it had already paid me more than two thousand dollars. That was, of course, completely untrue, because I had never received any money from them.
